sql: SELECT id, status FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, CASE WHEN sluice_src.status IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN length(sluice_src.status::varchar) <= ($2 + $4) THEN repeat($3, length(sluice_src.status::varchar)) ELSE concat(substr(sluice_src.status::varchar, 1, $2), repeat($3, (length(sluice_src.status::varchar) - $2) - $4), substr(sluice_src.status::varchar, (length(sluice_src.status::varchar) - $4) + 1)) END AS status, sluice_src.total FROM pg.public.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.status <> $1) orders WHERE status = 'o***'
